overall_goal: Record nutritional values of ingredients, season the salad, put away clean dishes, and wash dirty dishes

goals.description: Record nutritional value of coriander and put ingredients away
goals.rationale: The person measures coriander, records its nutritional value on their phone, and puts the ingredients back into the refrigerator.

goals.description: Add avocado to salad, record nutritional value, and clean up leftovers
goals.rationale: The person records the nutritional value of an avocado, adds it to the salad, puts the leftover half in the fridge, and throws away the scraps.

goals.description: Season salad and record nutritional values
goals.rationale: The person seasons the salad with salt, pepper, and oregano, and records their nutritional values on their phone.

goals.description: Put away clean dishes and utensils
goals.rationale: The person takes various clean items like a pan, bowl, coffee cup, knives, and spatulas from the dish rack and puts them away in cabinets and drawers.
The person gathers multiple tupperware containers, stacks them, and organizes them inside the kitchen cabinet to make space.

goals.description: Put away remaining clean dishes and utensils
goals.rationale: The person continues emptying the dish rack by putting away a small plate, wine glass, cocktail mixer, and spoons.

goals.description: Gather dirty dishes and prepare to wash
goals.rationale: The person collects dirty items like a cutting board, knife, scale, peeler, and brush, places them in or near the sink, and prepares a soapy sponge.

goals.description: Wash knife, plates, and food container
goals.rationale: The person uses the soapy sponge to wash a knife, small plates, and an empty food container, then places them in the dish rack to dry.

goals.description: Wash kitchen brush, cutting board, and peeler
goals.rationale: The person finishes washing the remaining dirty items, including a kitchen brush, cutting board, and peeler, before turning off the sink.
